items_all.title: 挪威擬推AI眼鏡臨時禁令，公共場所與校園成管制重點
items_all.summary: 挪威政府準備提出AI眼鏡臨時禁令，限制民眾在特定場所使用相關裝置，可能納入的地點包括公園、海灘、博物館、購物中心、學校與醫療院所等。禁令目前尚未生效，挪威政府將盡快向國會提出法案，實際適用場所及受管制裝置範圍仍待確認。 政府主要擔心，這類裝置可在旁人不知情的情況下拍照、錄影或錄音。規畫中的管制範圍包括民眾經常出入的公園、海灘、博物館與購物中心，也可能涵蓋遊樂園，以及體育、音樂與文化活動。

items_all.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
items_all.summary: Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk. The article Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Meta 與 微軟 這兩個 Anthropic's 最大規模的企業客戶，正在大幅減少對 Claude 的使用。微軟 將其雲端部門中每位員工每月的預算從 100,000 美元砍至 10,000 美元，而 Meta 則將其 Claude Code 用戶數減半至 30,000 名。兩家公司都在積極推廣自己的 AI 工具來取而代之。對 Anthropic 而言，這種對少數主要客戶的依賴正轉變成一項策略風險。本文 Meta 和 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items_all.summary: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Reka AI 的 Rho-1 是一個擁有 190 億個引數的全方位模型（omni-model），能在單一神經網路中處理並生成文字、圖片、影片及機器人控制動作。它在 320 個 H100 GPU 上訓練了大約三個月，所使用的運算資源僅佔當今頂尖模型所需的一小部分。Rho-1 沒有將任務分派給專門的系統，而是將所有模態作為 Token 執行在同一個共享的上下文視窗中。這篇「Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
items_all.summary: According to a Quinnipiac University poll, 77 percent of Americans want to slow down or stop AI development until its safety has been verified. 86 percent support independent safety standards, and 74 percent have little or no trust in AI company leaders. "[…] the public wants safeguards that do not depend simply on taking company leaders at their word," said researcher Chetan Jaiswal. The article Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據昆尼皮亞克大學（Quinnipiac University）的一項民調顯示，77% 的美國人希望放慢或停止人工智慧發展，直到其安全性得到驗證。86% 的人支持獨立的安全標準，74% 的人對人工智慧公司領導者幾乎沒有或完全沒有信任。「……大眾希望有的防護措施，不只是單純相信公司領導者的一面之詞，」研究人員切坦·賈斯瓦（Chetan Jaiswal）表示。《大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止，新民調顯示》（Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds）一文最早出現於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Anthropic is quietly becoming America's biggest corporate donor ahead of its mega IPO
items_all.summary: Anthropic employees donated $540 million in 2025 alone, nearly five times as much as the next-largest Fortune 500 donors, thanks to a company program that tops up every stock donation with extra shares and triples contributions from early employees. items_all.title: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty
items_all.summary: Aleph Alpha has released Kolibri, a German-English mixture-of-experts model with 78 billion parameters, about three billion of which are active per token. Over 21 percent of the training data is German. The model was trained on 768 B200 GPUs in Germany and Finland, and the weights are freely available under the Apache 2.0 license. The article Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Aleph Alpha 推出了 Kolibri，這是一個擁有 780 億個參數的德英混合專家模型，每個 token 約有 30 億個參數處於活躍狀態。超過 21% 的訓練資料是德語。該模型在德國和芬蘭的 768 個 B200 GPU 上進行訓練，其權重以 Apache 2.0 授權條款免費提供。本文〈Aleph Alpha 發布 Kolibri，一款為歐洲 AI 主權發聲的開放權重模型〉（Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty）最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds
items_all.summary: An MIT expert committee warns that AI is eroding key parts of the college experience: office hours, study groups, and the school's flagship research program for undergraduates are all fading. Trust between faculty and students is breaking down, and some professors are even considering AI agents instead of students as research assistants. The university most closely tied to AI's origin story is now calling for a complete overhaul of higher education. The article AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 麻省理工學院（MIT）專家委員會警告，AI 正在侵蝕大學體驗的關鍵部分：辦公時間、讀書會以及該校的標誌性大學生研究計畫都在逐漸消失。教職員與學生之間的信任正在瓦解，部分教授甚至考慮使用 AI 代理而非學生擔任研究助理。這所與 AI 起源故事最緊密相連的大學，現在正呼籲對高等教育進行全面改革。這篇題為「MIT 報告發現：AI 正在侵蝕辦公時間、讀書會以及教職員與學生之間的信任」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
items_all.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Reka 推出了 Rho-1，這是一個從頭開始訓練的 190 億參數全能推理模型。單一網路透過共用的 KV 快取來讀取和生成文字、圖像、影片及機器人動作。其蒸餾版本能在約一秒內回傳 5.3 秒的剪輯。這是一個研究預覽版，目前尚未公開模型權重。這篇文章 Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields
items_all.summary: JEPA-Anything splits a JEPA's single latent target into 4 orthogonal factors, each with its own predictor. Tested across 7 domains, it beat matched JEPA baselines on all 10 dynamics tasks and cut Interventional Pong intervention error by 34.8%. The post Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: JEPA-Anything 將 JEPA 的單一潛在目標拆分為 4 個正交因素，每個因素都有自己的預測器。經過 7 個領域的測試，它在所有 10 個動態任務上都擊敗了匹配的 JEPA 基線，並將介入式乓球（Interventional Pong）的介入誤差降低了 34.8%。這篇題為「超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域」的文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode
items_all.summary: Together AI has released Together Link, a free, MIT-licensed CLI that connects Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps to open models like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3. One install command sets it up, and an Auto router picks a model for each session. Together claims savings of over 50%. The post Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Together AI 全新奨出 Together Link，這是一款免費、採用 MIT 授權的 CLI，它可將 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Pi 以及 Claude 與 ChatGPT 桌面應用程式連線到 Kimi K3 和 GLM 5.3 等開放源模型。只需一個安裝命令即可完成設定，且自動路由器會為每個關暸選擇模型。Together 表示成本可灩省 50% 以上。本文首發於 MarkTechPost，標題為《Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode》。

items_all.title: Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads
items_all.summary: Reflection AI has introduced Beam, its first open-weight model. It is a 501B sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 23B active parameters, built for coding and agentic work. Reflection says it matches GLM-5.2 on reasoning with 3 to 4x less inference compute. Apache 2.0 weights are due later in October 2026. The post Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Reflection AI 推出了其首款開放權重的模型 Beam。這是一款 501B 的稀疏混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型，擁有 23B 的活躍參數，專為程式編寫與代理式工作（agentic work）所打造。Reflection 表示，它在推理能力上與 GLM-5.2 相當，但推理運算量卻減少了 3 到 4 倍。採用 Apache 2.0 授權的權重預計將於 2026 年 10 月下旬釋出。這篇文章 Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Our minds aren’t equipped to handle AI
items_all.summary: Norbert Wiener, godfather of cybernetics, once said, "The thought of every age is reflected in its technique." For the past century, our thought has been reflected in our computers, including by those in the AI industry. Google's Demis Hassabis calls the brain "a biological approximation to a Turing machine." Elon Musk puts it more bluntly, […]

items_all.title: Quoting Felix Rieseberg
items_all.summary: The "old" version of Cowork runs model inference in the cloud, executing tool calls in an Anthropic-provided VM we shipped to your computer. We added the VM for capability, safety, and security reasons - mapping in just the data you explicitly added to your session. People loved what they were able to do with Claude but didn't love the disk, battery, and performance cost of running the VM locally. Also, people didn't love that closing your laptop means the work stops. The "new" version of Cowork runs model inference and the VM in the cloud. Each session gets its own sandbox, not sharing state with other sessions. When the VM needs something on the users' device (like a file), the desktop app is responsible for that file access tool call. [...] We think this solves a lot of problems we've heard about (like using Cowork from a phone, keeping work running, or getting all the same power without losing battery to the VM) — Felix Rieseberg , Anthropic, see also this help page Tags: claude-cowork , anthropic , claude , generative-ai , ai , general-agents , llms

items_all_raw.title: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
items_all_raw.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Reka 推出了 Rho-1，這是一個從頭開始訓練的 190 億參數全能推理模型。單一網路透過共用的 KV 快取來讀取和生成文字、圖像、影片及機器人動作。其蒸餾版本能在約一秒內回傳 5.3 秒的剪輯。這是一個研究預覽版，目前尚未公開模型權重。這篇文章 Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields
items_all_raw.summary: JEPA-Anything splits a JEPA's single latent target into 4 orthogonal factors, each with its own predictor. Tested across 7 domains, it beat matched JEPA baselines on all 10 dynamics tasks and cut Interventional Pong intervention error by 34.8%. The post Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: JEPA-Anything 將 JEPA 的單一潛在目標拆分為 4 個正交因素，每個因素都有自己的預測器。經過 7 個領域的測試，它在所有 10 個動態任務上都擊敗了匹配的 JEPA 基線，並將介入式乓球（Interventional Pong）的介入誤差降低了 34.8%。這篇題為「超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域」的文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: 挪威擬推AI眼鏡臨時禁令，公共場所與校園成管制重點
items_all_raw.summary: 挪威政府準備提出AI眼鏡臨時禁令，限制民眾在特定場所使用相關裝置，可能納入的地點包括公園、海灘、博物館、購物中心、學校與醫療院所等。禁令目前尚未生效，挪威政府將盡快向國會提出法案，實際適用場所及受管制裝置範圍仍待確認。 政府主要擔心，這類裝置可在旁人不知情的情況下拍照、錄影或錄音。規畫中的管制範圍包括民眾經常出入的公園、海灘、博物館與購物中心，也可能涵蓋遊樂園，以及體育、音樂與文化活動。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Felix Rieseberg
items_all_raw.summary: The "old" version of Cowork runs model inference in the cloud, executing tool calls in an Anthropic-provided VM we shipped to your computer. We added the VM for capability, safety, and security reasons - mapping in just the data you explicitly added to your session. People loved what they were able to do with Claude but didn't love the disk, battery, and performance cost of running the VM locally. Also, people didn't love that closing your laptop means the work stops. The "new" version of Cowork runs model inference and the VM in the cloud. Each session gets its own sandbox, not sharing state with other sessions. When the VM needs something on the users' device (like a file), the desktop app is responsible for that file access tool call. [...] We think this solves a lot of problems we've heard about (like using Cowork from a phone, keeping work running, or getting all the same power without losing battery to the VM) — Felix Rieseberg , Anthropic, see also this help page Tags: claude-cowork , anthropic , claude , generative-ai , ai , general-agents , llms

items_all_raw.title: Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads
items_all_raw.summary: Reflection AI has introduced Beam, its first open-weight model. It is a 501B sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 23B active parameters, built for coding and agentic work. Reflection says it matches GLM-5.2 on reasoning with 3 to 4x less inference compute. Apache 2.0 weights are due later in October 2026. The post Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Reflection AI 推出了其首款開放權重的模型 Beam。這是一款 501B 的稀疏混合專家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型，擁有 23B 的活躍參數，專為程式編寫與代理式工作（agentic work）所打造。Reflection 表示，它在推理能力上與 GLM-5.2 相當，但推理運算量卻減少了 3 到 4 倍。採用 Apache 2.0 授權的權重預計將於 2026 年 10 月下旬釋出。這篇文章 Reflection AI Introduces Beam: A 501B Open-Weight MoE Model With 23B Active Parameters for Coding and Agentic Workloads 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
items_all_raw.summary: Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000. Both companies are pushing their own AI tools instead. For Anthropic, that reliance on a few major clients is turning into a strategic risk. The article Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Meta 與 微軟 這兩個 Anthropic's 最大規模的企業客戶，正在大幅減少對 Claude 的使用。微軟 將其雲端部門中每位員工每月的預算從 100,000 美元砍至 10,000 美元，而 Meta 則將其 Claude Code 用戶數減半至 30,000 名。兩家公司都在積極推廣自己的 AI 工具來取而代之。對 Anthropic 而言，這種對少數主要客戶的依賴正轉變成一項策略風險。本文 Meta 和 微軟 自 Claude 撤回，因 Anthropic 從合作夥伴轉變成競爭對手，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items_all_raw.summary: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. The article Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Reka AI 的 Rho-1 是一個擁有 190 億個引數的全方位模型（omni-model），能在單一神經網路中處理並生成文字、圖片、影片及機器人控制動作。它在 320 個 H100 GPU 上訓練了大約三個月，所使用的運算資源僅佔當今頂尖模型所需的一小部分。Rho-1 沒有將任務分派給專門的系統，而是將所有模態作為 Token 執行在同一個共享的上下文視窗中。這篇「Reka AI 的全方位模型 Rho-1 在單一模型中處理文字、圖片、影片和機器人控制」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds
items_all_raw.summary: According to a Quinnipiac University poll, 77 percent of Americans want to slow down or stop AI development until its safety has been verified. 86 percent support independent safety standards, and 74 percent have little or no trust in AI company leaders. "[…] the public wants safeguards that do not depend simply on taking company leaders at their word," said researcher Chetan Jaiswal. The article Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據昆尼皮亞克大學（Quinnipiac University）的一項民調顯示，77% 的美國人希望放慢或停止人工智慧發展，直到其安全性得到驗證。86% 的人支持獨立的安全標準，74% 的人對人工智慧公司領導者幾乎沒有或完全沒有信任。「……大眾希望有的防護措施，不只是單純相信公司領導者的一面之詞，」研究人員切坦·賈斯瓦（Chetan Jaiswal）表示。《大多數美國人希望人工智慧發展放慢或完全停止，新民調顯示》（Most Americans want AI development to slow down or stop entirely, new poll finds）一文最早出現於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty
items_all_raw.summary: Aleph Alpha has released Kolibri, a German-English mixture-of-experts model with 78 billion parameters, about three billion of which are active per token. Over 21 percent of the training data is German. The model was trained on 768 B200 GPUs in Germany and Finland, and the weights are freely available under the Apache 2.0 license. The article Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Aleph Alpha 推出了 Kolibri，這是一個擁有 780 億個參數的德英混合專家模型，每個 token 約有 30 億個參數處於活躍狀態。超過 21% 的訓練資料是德語。該模型在德國和芬蘭的 768 個 B200 GPU 上進行訓練，其權重以 Apache 2.0 授權條款免費提供。本文〈Aleph Alpha 發布 Kolibri，一款為歐洲 AI 主權發聲的開放權重模型〉（Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, an open-weight model that makes the case for European AI sovereignty）最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds
items_all_raw.summary: An MIT expert committee warns that AI is eroding key parts of the college experience: office hours, study groups, and the school's flagship research program for undergraduates are all fading. Trust between faculty and students is breaking down, and some professors are even considering AI agents instead of students as research assistants. The university most closely tied to AI's origin story is now calling for a complete overhaul of higher education. The article AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 麻省理工學院（MIT）專家委員會警告，AI 正在侵蝕大學體驗的關鍵部分：辦公時間、讀書會以及該校的標誌性大學生研究計畫都在逐漸消失。教職員與學生之間的信任正在瓦解，部分教授甚至考慮使用 AI 代理而非學生擔任研究助理。這所與 AI 起源故事最緊密相連的大學，現在正呼籲對高等教育進行全面改革。這篇題為「MIT 報告發現：AI 正在侵蝕辦公時間、讀書會以及教職員與學生之間的信任」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Our minds aren’t equipped to handle AI
items_all_raw.summary: Norbert Wiener, godfather of cybernetics, once said, "The thought of every age is reflected in its technique." For the past century, our thought has been reflected in our computers, including by those in the AI industry. Google's Demis Hassabis calls the brain "a biological approximation to a Turing machine." Elon Musk puts it more bluntly, […]
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 控制論之父諾伯特・維納（Norbert Wiener）曾說：「每個時代的思想都反映在其技術中。」在過去的一個世紀裡，我們的思想一直反映在我們的電腦中，包括人工智慧產業中的電腦。Google's 德米斯・哈薩比斯（Demis Hassabis）將大腦稱為「圖靈機的生物學近似物」。埃隆・馬斯克（Elon Musk）則說得更直白，［…］
